verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships first-class TypeScript typings with 'full IntelliSense' and generated TypeDoc API references, which any standard TS-aware editor/LSP (tsserver) can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation — satisfying the spirit of typed API definitions for agent tooling. However, there is no dedicated official Babylon-specific language server, and no independent/community evidence confirming agent-editor attach behavior in practice. Missing for 10: a purpose-built LSP, and third-party corroboration that coding agents actually get reliable completions/diagnostics/navigation via these typings.
